text:
ana: Hit a weird onboarding blocker today. Using SAML SSO (IdP-initiated) to get a CLI session token and the starter quickstart POST to /v1/chat returns 403 billing: workspace_unprovisioned on the first call even though the org is provisioned in the console. Anyone seen SAML mapping issues?

ana: logs from the gateway:```
2026-03-26T14:20:01Z auth: validated saml assertion NameID=alice@acme.com Issuer=https://idp.acme/saml
2026-03-26T14:20:01Z caller=provision check=failed msg="no_org_mapping: saml_nameid_missing_expected_claims"
2026-03-26T14:20:02Z caller=client.go status=403 msg="billing: workspace_unprovisioned"
```

derek: SAML assertions can be weird across different IdP configs. Some IdPs put the email in subject, some in an attribute like `mail` or `email`. Our provisioning logic currently looks for `email` or `org_claim` and sometimes `sub`. If the assertion uses `NameID` or a custom attribute we don't map it automatically.

ana: the token I got from the CLI has a `sub` that looks like `saml:alice` and there is an attribute `eduPersonPrincipalName` with alice@acme.com. The quickstart container's sample code only picks up `email` claim.

derek: short-term workaround: include x-redwood-org header with the org id in your requests or set REDWOOD_ORG env in the quickstart container so the sample code sends the header. Example curl that worked for me:```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SAML_TOKEN" \
  -H "x-redwood-org: org_09QWE" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-mini","input":"hello"}'
```

ana: adding header got me a first-call 200 and stream start. Verified in the response: stream opened and messages started arriving.

ops-bot: note: quickstart-saml patch v0.2.1 deployed to staging 2026-03-26T13:50:00Z 1: adds REDWOOD_ORG env support and a small SAML-attribute diagnostic endpoint.

derek: longer-term fix: we should expand the identity mapper to look at common SAML attributes (mail, email, eduPersonPrincipalName, uid, NameID) and allow configurable attribute mapping per org. Also add a helpful onboarding error: instead of `workspace_unprovisioned` return `missing_identity_mapping` plus guidance ("if using SAML, ensure email is present or send x-redwood-org header; see quickstart SAML notes").

ana: SDK parity thing: the Go SDK returns a plain 403 error string, Python SDK returns a structured dict with code `workspace_unprovisioned`. Both are confusing. We should return a stable error code `missing_org_mapping` across SDKs. Filed INF-5100 to track SDK parity + improved error code/messages.

derek: filed INF-5099 to broaden SAML attribute mapping and INF-5100 for SDK parity. Assigning both to devex + eng-auth.

devex-bot: roll forward: payg-provisioning-guard v1.3.5 rolled out 2026-03-26T13:45:00Z 1: tightened mapping heuristics; creating INF-5099/INF-5100 for DX workarounds.

ana: thanks everyone. For anyone doing SAML IdP-initiated flows right now, temp fix is REDWOOD_ORG header or use an org-scoped token. The quickstart SAML README will get a short diagnostic and example by EOD. :thumbsup:
